About Us

Clean, comfortable, and genuinely affordable

Sunshine Guest House sits in the heart of Mdantsane, offering a peaceful base whether you're here for business, a family visit, or exploring the Eastern Cape. We keep our rooms spotless, our rates fair, and our welcome warm.

Guests enjoy quick, easy access to East London, nearby beaches, business hubs, and the region's top attractions — all while coming back each evening to a quiet, secure place to rest.
